blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `batchLinkProductsToCategoryStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step manages the links between a category and products.

```ts
const data = batchLinkProductsToCategoryStep({
  id: "pcat_123",
  add: ["product_123"],
  remove: ["product_321"]
})
```

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the data model to create links to or remove links from.

children.name: add
children.description: The IDs of the other data models to create links to the record specified in `id`.

children.name: remove
children.description: The IDs of the other data models to remove links from the record specified in `id`.
